title: Coast Guard Reserve conducts training at Muscatatuck Urban Search and Rescue Center
description: Coast Guard Reserve members conduct flood response training at the Muscatatuck Urban Search and Rescue Center in Indiana, Aug, 8, 2026. Reserve members practice specialized boat operations, navigation in confined urban areas and rescue scenarios to prepare for disaster response and ensure reserve teams are ready to deploy and support communities affected by flooding. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Chief Petty Officer Brandon Giles and Petty Officer 3rd Class Michael Lauofo)
keywords: Coast Guard Reserve, Flood response training, Coast Guard, Indiana, Urban Search & Rescue
credit: Chief Petty Officer Brandon Giles, Petty Officer 3rd Class Michael Lauofo
